Create a faithful DESKTOP 1280px-wide, long scrolling visual study of the CURRENT PUBLIC Sanity homepage as observed 2026-09-28 at https://www.sanity.io/. This is not an invented Sanity-branded app. Follow the dated official reference content and hierarchy below exactly; do not invent performance claims, logos, article titles, or prices.

First viewport: 36px white top announcement strip reading "Everything *[NYC] 2026: see what we announced. →" centered in tiny dark mono text. A transparent/dark ~64px nav overlays the hero: white Sanity wordmark far left, compact uppercase mono Products, Solutions, Resources, Docs, Enterprise, Pricing, then Login, outlined white Contact Sales pill and vivid orange #ff5500 Get Started pill right. Full-bleed very dark video/collage background with content cards, magazine imagery and dim text, covered by dark scrim; this is visual media, not a generic gradient. Left aligned x24 white Waldenburg-like giant 112px tightly tracked H1 over two lines: "The Content" / "Operations Platform". Beneath at y410 a large ~32px two-line white sentence: "Power content applications and AI workflows at scale. Every application, one platform." At y520 a row of orange Start building pill (black text), white Watch demo pill (black text), thin outlined terminal command pill "npm create sanity@latest" with copy icon. At viewport bottom, a solid vivid orange full-width horizontal rail of black customer logos including Figma, Redis, Replit, Anthropic, Spotify, Linear, Skims, Arc'teryx, Complex, Brex. The hero has no white card, no pastel.

Continue page in order with black / #0b0b0b backgrounds, large white headings and source-specific product displays: (1) dark customer outcome row with Braze "-98% TRANSLATION TURNAROUND WITH AI AGENTS", PUMA "50k REUSABLE STRUCTURED CONTENT PIECES", Complex "80h EDITORIAL TIME SAVED PER MONTH", plus Book a demo. (2) "Mirror how your content operations team works", with the genuine-looking Sanity Studio demo: a wide black product composition of code editor hero.ts, Studio / Homepage / Hero form fields, history timeline and content release panels; edge to edge at desktop with fine gray rules. (3) "Content Operations without the busywork" and sentence "Agent actions, functions, and content agents automate manual work before and after hitting publish." with UPDATE REFERENCES / TRANSLATE WITH AI / DELEGATE FROM ELSEWHERE tabs and black programming/workflow displays. (4) "Power anything. One API, every platform" and sentence "Turn your content into a governed knowledge layer that powers applications and AI agents." with dark Sanity Context marketing-bot console. (5) "Everything your team needs in one place" with five numbered horizontal chapter labels CONTENT-AS-DATA, EDITORIAL FREEDOM, CONTENT AGENT, AUTOMATION AT SCALE, POWER ANY APPLICATION; detailed alternating dark product feature areas, first title "The database optimized for content operations". (6) "Loved by 1M+ users and 6k+ teams" with real customer quote style and 01/02/03 selectors. (7) "Enterprise-grade everything" and "Less talk, more code" with CLI Install, MCP Server, Agent toolkit columns. (8) dense dark footer with product/resource/company/legal link columns.

Typography must remain unusually large and compact; high-contrast monochrome, subtle gray strokes, almost no rounded cards except real code/product panels; vivid orange only for CTA/logo rail and a few highlights. Match section spacing and desktop responsive proportions. Preserve actual Sanity brand look.
